scripts.db:setup: npm run docker:up && bash scripts/wait-for-db.sh && npm run db:migrate && npm run seed
scripts.db:init: npm run db:migrate && npm run seed
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres-primary redis && bash scripts/wait-for-db.sh && npm run db:migrate && npm run seed
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d && bash scripts/wait-for-db.sh && npm run db:migrate && concurrently "cd guessx-web && npm run dev" "bash scripts/wait-for-services.sh 90"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run docker:up && bash scripts/wait-for-db.sh && concurrently "cd backend && npm install" "cd guessx-web && npm install" "cd guessx-app && npm install" && npm run db:migrate && npm run seed
scripts.start:
echo '
  ⚡ Guess X

  npm run dev     Full stack: Docker → backends → frontend
  npm run app     Mobile app (Expo)
  npm run db:setup  Docker → migrate → seed
  npm run db:init   Migrate → seed (requires Docker running)
  npm run seed      Seed database
  npm run services  Backends only (requires Docker)
  npm run clean     Remove build artifacts and caches
  npm run clean:deep  Also remove node_modules (npm run setup to restore)
'
